sources.title: Official rules (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText:
SYNTHETIC CIVIC HACK — RULES
The hack runs 2031-09-20 08:00 UTC to 2031-09-21 18:00 UTC. Existing code may be used if it is clearly identified. Judging is an expo with four minutes per team.

sources.title: Overall rubric (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText: Overall rubric, scored 1-5: Civic impact 50%, Execution 50%.

sources.title: Health track (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText: HEALTH TRACK — projects must not collect real patient data. Track rubric, scored 1-5: Safety 60%, Accessibility 40%.

sources.title: Education track (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText: EDUCATION TRACK — projects must be usable by learners aged 12 and over.

sources.title: Organizer guidance (synthetic)
sources.normalizedText: Organizers encourage teams to talk to local community groups before building.
